title: Chords from one scale
summary: Keep every chord note inside the key.

steps.title: Chords from one scale
steps.body:
**diatonic chord** means a chord made only from notes of the key. C major has C, D, E, F, G, A and B. C, E and G belong to that list, so C major is diatonic to C major.

**Why it matters:** A key gives you a small family of chords to start with.

steps.title: See it on the fretboard
steps.body: Use string 5 fret 3 for C3, string 4 fret 2 for E3 and string 3 open for G3. All three notes come from the C major scale.

items.prompt: Play C, E and G together. Use any positions for these notes.

steps.title: Explore the sounds
steps.body: Compare Dm with D. F belongs to C major; F# does not. A familiar shape can belong to one key and sit outside another.
